boundary_reason: Stable policy selection of 80 revisions, no source-identity truncation. Source verification is not semantic completion.

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Trollmire and vanquished Shax the Troll.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了巨魔沼泽并击败了巨魔夏克斯。#WHITE#
0 表示不使用这个技能，1 为默认

entries.source: You must dual wield to manage contact with your target!
entries.target: 你只有在双持状态下才能使用这个技能！

entries.source: Black blood for foul deeds. This dagger serves evil.
entries.target: 为邪恶行径而流的黑血。这把匕首侍奉着邪恶。

entries.source: Er, it seems that while you were out, somebody else managed to bring me the ingredients. I've got no reward for you! Sorry about that, but when time is of the essence, 'first come, first served' is the only sensible policy.
entries.target: 呃，好像你不在的时候，已经有人把材料给我弄来了，我不会再给你奖励了。很抱歉，不过时间才是最重要的，“先来者先得”，你得记住这句话。

entries.source:
This incredibly beautiful -- and powerful -- trident is made of the rare metal orichalcum. An amazing pearl is seated in head of the trident, as it spreads into three razor sharp prongs.
It is imbued with the greatest strengths of all of the most powerful Naga warriors.
Slasul gave it to you as a sign of his faith in you. It is a sign of hope for all of the Naloren race, that one outside of their tribe could be so trusted.
entries.target:
这柄拥有着强大力量的三叉戟通体由奥利哈刚金属打造而成。一颗闪亮的珍珠镶嵌在其顶端，向前延伸而出的，是三道锋利的三叉戟刃。
它被灌输了娜迦即纳鲁精灵一族最强大战士的力量。
现在，萨拉苏尔将它赐予你，作为他对你的信任。同时，它也寄托了纳鲁一族的希望，只有你能受到他们如此的信任。
你要出售%d个%s，获得 %0.2f 金币%s吗？

entries.source:
There is an inscription here:
#{italic}#...The eldritch force burns all that lives.#{normal}#
entries.target:
这里有一段铭文：
#{italic}#……奥术之力以火焰焚尽一切生灵。#{normal}#

entries.source:
Toggles between various tactical information display:
- Combined healthbar and small tactical frame
- Combined healthbar and big tactical frame
- Only healthbar
- No tactical information at all

#{italic}#You can also change this directly ingame by pressing shift+T.#{normal}##WHITE#
entries.target:
切换战术信息显示模式：
- 生命值条+小框架
- 生命值条+大框架
- 只显示生命值条
- 不显示

#{italic}#在游戏中按Shift+T可以直接切换#{normal}##WHITE#
#VIOLET#泽梅基斯说道：“传送门已经开启！”

entries.source: and integrated into the crystaline structure
entries.target: 并被它的水晶结构所吸收

entries.source: As you walk into the area you notice a huge snowstorm over your head. Beware!
entries.target: 当你进入这个区域时，你感觉到一股暴风雪在你的头顶盘旋。小心！
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +3 力量，+1 敏捷，+5 体质

entries.source: The target is maimed, reducing damage by %d and global speed by 30%%.
entries.target: 目标被致残，伤害减少 %d 并且全局速度下降 30%%。

entries.source: After your victory you came back to Last Hope and reunited with Melinda, who after many years remains free of demonic corruption.
entries.target: 在你的胜利之后，你回到了最后的希望，并与梅琳达重聚，梅琳达在许多年后没有再受到恶魔腐化的影响。

entries.source: Your golem cannot do that currently.
entries.target: 你的傀儡现在不能使用该技能。

entries.source: #Target# is no longer embeded in time.

You extract corrupted blood from your own body, hitting everything in a frontal cone of radius %d for %0.2f blight damage.
		Each creature hit has a %d%% chance of being infected by a random disease, doing %0.2f blight damage and weakening either Constitution, Strength or Dexterity for 6 turns.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
你从自身射出堕落之血，对前方 %d 码半径锥形范围敌人造成 %0.2f 枯萎伤害。
		每个受影响的单位有 %d%% 概率感染 1 种随机疾病，受到 %0.2f 枯萎伤害，并且随机弱化目标体质、力量和敏捷中的一项属性，持续 6 回合。
		伤害受法术强度加成。
为了维网！去死吧，邪教徒！

entries.source: Space and time distort and lose meaning as you pass through the rift. This place is alien.
entries.target: 当你穿过裂隙时，时空扭曲、失去了意义。这个地方令人感到陌生。
曾造成超过 50000 点精神伤害

entries.source: In an effort to make your dread more annoying you focus a shell of darkness around it, rendering it fully invincible for %d turns.
entries.target: 你使用一层暗影包裹你召唤的噩灵，以便最大限度给敌人带来扰乱。噩灵在 %d 回合内进入无敌状态。

entries.source: A vial of thick, lumpy fluid. Who knows what this will do to you if you drink it?
entries.target: 一瓶粘稠的浑浊液体。天知道你喝了它之后会发生什么？

entries.source: A dark hole in the mountain
Increases all your summons' max life by %0.1f%% and extends your summons' maximum lifetime by %d turns.
entries.target: 提升你所有召唤物的生命值 %0.1f%%，并延长所有召唤物的存活时间 %d 回合。

entries.source: Dispatched the Weirdling Beast and took possession of Yiilkgur, the Sher'Tul Fortress for your own usage.
entries.target: 除去异形触手并控制伊克格，夏·图尔堡垒成为你的私有物。

entries.source: A large dark blue arachnid with a shifting yellow and white pattern on its thorax.  It shifts and shimmers as though only partially connected to the timeline.
entries.target: 一只巨大的深蓝色蛛形生物，胸部有着不断变幻的黄白花纹。它不停地晃动闪烁，仿佛只是部分连接在时间线上。

entries.source:
How long will flying text messages be visible on screen.
The range is 1 (very short) to 100 (10x slower) than the normal duration, which varies with each individual message.
entries.target:
更改角色上方闪过提示的停留时间。
1表示停留很短，100表示停留10倍时间，不同消息停留时间不同。

entries.source:
#{bold}#
Tania Pure-Hearted
#{normal}#78 - 115#{italic}#
Our tears are for ourselves
To have lost one so bright as you
#{normal}#
entries.target:
#{bold}#
纯心者塔尼亚
#{normal}#78 - 115#{italic}#
我们的眼泪为自己而流
因失去了你这样的明灯
#{normal}#

entries.source: Then you will die like Kyless. #LIGHT_GREEN#[Attack]#LAST#
entries.target: 那么你也会像克里斯一样死去。#LIGHT_GREEN#[攻击]#LAST#

entries.source: Who knows what dark thoughts drive people to necromancy? Its art is as old as magic itself, and its creations have plagued all the races since the earliest memories.
entries.target: 天知道是怎样的堕落思想才能使一个人成为死灵法师。这门艺术就像魔法一样历史悠久，它的出现在最初的岁月里给所有种族带来了非常的劫难。
